completion:
Ask an accountant if you are not sure.
3. Calculate the loss with this method:
   - Gross income minus operating expenses equals Net income (or Net loss).
4. The disclosure also needs to contain a statement of quarterly income/loss and any changes from a prior FY.

*Income and Expenses referred to in Section 21.1*: The company needs to already be calculating these figures, via its standard accounting process. They are already in your accounting system it should just be a matter of setting up a query for the right fields (please ask the accountant if you need help, or the program general services). Here is a more detailed list showing how these figures are typically arrived at:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Direct revenue} + \text{ancillary revenue} + \text{grants/accts rec} &= \text{Total revenue (gross income)} \\
\text{Total
